decisive_items: a swollen and thickened tubular structure measuring 36 × 27 mm at the cecal pole
a 25‐mm pericecal collection adjacent to surgical clips
response.rationale: Prior appendectomy with an inflamed appendiceal stump can produce a swollen tubular cecal-pole structure and pericecal abscess; the CT findings and adjacent surgical clips favor appendiceal abscess over a delayed post-surgical abscess, and diverticulitis/neutropenic colitis are less consistent.

rejected.why: Right-sided diverticulitis can mimic appendicitis, but the tubular cecal-pole structure and adjacent surgical clips after appendectomy favor an appendiceal stump abscess.
Neutropenic colitis requires neutropenia, whereas the WBC count is markedly elevated with 85% neutrophils.
